_comment: Canonical tool name -> executable per implementation. cpp = C++ TauDEM executable stem (resolved case-insensitively, with or without .exe). rs = taudem-rs subcommand; null = not implemented yet, so parity steps using it are SKIPPED for rs. When taudem-rs gains a tool, set its subcommand here and the matching parity cases start running.

rs._comment: How a rank count maps to taudem-rs parallelism. threads_flag, when set, is appended as '<flag> N'; threads_env, when set, is exported as N. Set both to null to ignore ranks for rs.

pipeline._comment: Fused pitremove -> d8flowdir -> aread8. {dem} {fel} {p} {sd8} {ad8} are substituted.
